title: N64: GLD MCS test — ALL 5 models in superior set (none eliminated), confirming gamma rule
description: Ran MCS test for GLD (2023-2024, 501 obs, 10000 bootstrap). All 5 models (GARCH-N/t, GJR-N/t/GED) are in the MCS superior set — none can be eliminated. This directly contrasts with SPY where GARCH was excluded (p=0.044). The contrast validates the gamma-based model selection rule: for SPY (gamma=0.21>0.10), GJR is provably superior; for GLD (gamma=-0.07<0), no model difference exists.
